name: Susurros del Corazón, Auberge Collection

address.street: Desarrollo El Banco Carretera a La Cruz de Huanacaxtle Km 14

insider_take: This ultra-exclusive adults-only resort sits on a pristine peninsula where the Pacific meets the Sierra Madre mountains, offering just 59 suites across 57 acres of untouched Mexican coastline.
whats_special: Located on the same exclusive peninsula as the Four Seasons and St. Regis, this Auberge Collection property features Mexico's only Jack Nicklaus-designed Tail of the Whale golf hole - a dramatic par-3 that plays to a green surrounded by ocean. The resort's name translates to "Whispers of the Heart," perfectly capturing its intimate, soul-stirring atmosphere.
pro_tip: Book tee times early morning or late afternoon for the famous Tail of the Whale hole - the lighting creates Instagram-worthy shots and you'll avoid peak heat while playing over crashing waves.
dont_miss: The nearby Islas Marietas National Park, home to the famous Hidden Beach (Playa del Amor) - a secret beach inside a crater accessible only by swimming through an underwater tunnel. Also explore the charming fishing village of Sayulita, just 20 minutes away, known for its vibrant street art and world-class surfing.
pros: Adults-only luxury resort with intimate atmosphere
Stunning oceanfront location in exclusive Punta Mita
Exceptional personalized service and attention to detail
cons: Adults-only policy may not suit all travelers
